title: TradeInCapabilities
description: Actual trade_in.submit behavior of one deployment. Publish in the A2A AAP extension params.skills["trade_in.submit"].capabilities and the MCP trade-in tool metadata; the same values apply to every binding.

instant_valuation.description: true when the dealer can answer with status valued in the same call. false means every accepted submission returns received.

contact_required.description: true when the dealer rejects a request without customer and consent with CONTACT_CONSENT_REQUIRED. false means anonymous estimates are served.

currencies.description: Currencies this skill accepts and returns. Omitted means only USD.
